methodology.call_site_rule: A capability nothing calls does not exist. A module IMPORT is not a call. A definition is not a call. tools/acceptance is treated as harness (supports TESTED, not INTEGRATED unless an hcli/ caller outside the defining file also exists). Defining-file-only self-calls do not wire.
methodology.acceptance_rule: A receipt is evidence of the criterion only when verdict=ACCEPTED, criterion_altered is not true, and the catalog symbol was actually invoked (or the receipt names equivalent invocations of that symbol). symbol_invoked=false refuses BUILT.
methodology.PHYSICALLY_MEASURED_unused: This audit did not run GPU/ANE/FPGA workloads. Inventory presence/absence was probed.
methodology.sparse_checkout: hcli/ and tools/roadmap are git blobs via git show / git grep HEAD, not worktree files.
methodology.scoring_note: INTEGRATED=80, END_TO_END=70, TESTED=50, CALLABLE=40, SCAFFOLDED=20, ABSENT/HW/AUTH=0. Old 25.7% is recorded as stated, not regenerated.
methodology.authority_limits: Not authoritative for GPU physical performance, Metal runtime behaviour not executed, ANE physical behaviour, U50/FPGA facts not physically measured, thermal/power, protected benchmarks.

unlock_question.question: HAS ANYTHING BUILT SINCE THE LAST AUDIT ACTUALLY UNLOCKED MORE ROADMAP COMPLETION?
unlock_question.answer: Less than it looks. Built/end-to-end is 18 → 16 under a call-of-the-symbol rule that also refuses acceptance receipts that did not invoke the catalog symbol. Scaffolded-or-better 66.2% → 69.0% is mostly reclassification (Theia out of ABSENT; existing files the old pass called absent). No new physical carrier appeared. The systems that actually moved a gate's strongest honest state are listed below; none of them closes a hardware gate or the EBPW<=1 / TPS>=50 bars.

moved_systems.what_changed: receipts/acceptance/AGENTOS_*.json and HCLI_CONTEXT_*.json / BACKEND_FAILURE_ISOLATION.json dated 2026-09-02. Pytest/harness demonstrated criteria for repair, cancel, orphan, persistence, checkpoint, restart, context authority, focused workunits, failure isolation.
moved_systems.effect: These gates are INTEGRATED or TESTED on STATIC_VERIFICATION of receipts, not PHYSICALLY_MEASURED. They were already source-present; the campaign added acceptance evidence. That is not a new runtime capability.
